connector.name: Umtri
connector.registryDescription: Give your AI agent a persistent map of your project's structure, dependencies, and bugs.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.umtri.io over streamable HTTP, also runs locally from the npm package umtri-mcp. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches all 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace io.umtri, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

env.name: UMTRI_API_TOKEN
env.description: Personal access token from app.umtri.io → Settings → API Tokens. Read tokens cannot call write tools.

env.name: UMTRI_API_BASE
env.description: Override the API base URL. Defaults to https://api.umtri.io — set only when self-hosting.
